name: Sightline
tagline: Your trading rules, in your line of sight.
description: Trading session on your G2: day PnL, positions, and one-tap Yes / No cards from rules you set. Bybit testnet.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Talks to your own Sightline server, which holds the exchange keys.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Voice shortcuts. Listens only after you tap, for up to 5 seconds. The audio goes to your Sightline server, which sends it to OpenAI for transcription.
